statement: For every noetherian local dyadic base R of finite Krull dimension, the stable exact category of R-free C2 lattices equals the full R-perfect kernel in Dsg(R[C2]) and the relative finite-projective matrix-factorization category of U(U+2) over R[U]; its K0 is Swan_R(C2) modulo the regular-module class
depends_on: C-BurkeWalker2012 Definition 2.6, Theorem 2.7 and Lemma B.6
notes: Categorical route clarification only. No idempotent completion is inserted; no injectivity into ambient singularity K0 or pencil support identification is asserted. The ramified-node comparison remains open.
